sophia: Quick FYI
We rolled q8x4 for sequoia-7 into staging last night and a tiny but consistent accuracy drop showed up on the "howto" promptset (micro-guides slice).

lee: How small is tiny? numbers?

sophia: ~5.6% drop in exact-match on the 1k golden. Not catastrophic but it's outside our regression threshold. I uploaded diffs: s3://redwood-qa/curation/q8x4/sequoia-7-diffs/ and a short repro.

omar: Can you paste the bench command you used? want to reproduce locally.

sophia: Ran: ```python -m bench.run --model=sequoia-7-q8x4 --prompts=promptsets/howto_v1.txt --out=logs/sequoia-q8x4-howto.log --seed=42```

rachel: Any pattern in failures? long answers? code snippets? formatting?

sophia: Mostly long step-by-step answers with inline bullets and some with NBSPs/soft-hyphen in the source. A handful are truncated mid-sentence, others replace product names with generic tokens.

lee: Could be tokenization normalization or quantization-induced softmax noise around repeated tokens. Also q8x4 interacts weirdly with attention softmax on long contexts in some archs.

label_ops_bot: label-ops: opening job #3137 097 re-eval 800-sample golden with dedupe=false and full context preserved. assignee: rachel. ETA ~1.5h.

rachel: I'll take the job. sophia can you export the 800 samples (dedupe off) and add expected labels to the manifest? prefer jsonl with fields {prompt,expected}.

sophia: Exported to /datasets/curation/q8x4-sequoia/recheck-800.jsonl and opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/curation/pull/558 (manifest + expected labels + notes).

omar: Meanwhile I'll run a small compare between sequoia-7-fp16 and sequoia-7-q8x4 on a 250-sample canary to see if the regression is precision-dependent. command: ```python -m bench.run --model=sequoia-7-q8x4 --compare-model=sequoia-7-fp16 --prompts=promptsets/canary/250-howto.txt --out=logs/q8x4-vs-fp16.json```

lee: Also propose a 40-example micro-golden focusing on edgecases: long numbered steps, code fenced blocks, NBSPs, soft-hyphen, and repeated entities. i'll assemble list at promptsets/micro-gold/q8x4-sequoia-edge-40.txt. rachel can label those for quick sanity.

rachel: yep will label. should we run on both staging and dedicated GPU to rule out runtime kernel differences?

sophia: good call. omar can you run canary on dedicated infra? if we see the same gap it's likely model/quant. if staging only maybe runtime/kernel mapping.

omar: running dedicated canary now, tagging results to the PR once done.

lee: small note: for the micro-golden, include a couple of prompts that previously flipped on int4 experiments, helps cross-check consistent failure modes.

sophia: action items: 1) rachel run re-eval job #3137 + label 800 2) lee assemble micro-gold-40 3) omar run fp16 vs q8x4 on dedicated and staging 4) sophia collect diffs and open regression ticket with logs and s3 links.

label_ops_bot: job #3137 status: queued.

rachel: starting labeling now. will report back with initial pass (~30m).

sophia: thanks all 
cc @omar @lee @rachel :thumbsup:
